tests.title: Rate-limit backoff sleeps via injectable function and retries once, failing with ErrRateLimited if duration exceeds 120s or retry fails
given: a mock server returning HTTP 429 with Retry-After header and a client configured with custom sleep function
tests.when: executing a request receiving HTTP 429
then: when Retry-After <= 120s, custom sleep function is invoked with backoff duration and request is retried once
when Retry-After > 120s or retried request fails, returns an error satisfying IsRateLimited(err) == true
tests.pseudocode:
var sleepDurations []time.Duration
mockSleep := func(d time.Duration) {
    sleepDurations = append(sleepDurations, d)
}

calls := 0
srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    calls++
    if r.URL.Path == "/retry-ok" && calls == 1 {
        w.Header().Set("Retry-After", "10")
        w.WriteHeader(http.StatusTooManyRequests)
        w.Write([]byte(`{"message": "Rate limit exceeded"}`))
        return
    }
    if r.URL.Path == "/retry-fail" {
        w.Header().Set("Retry-After", "5")
        w.WriteHeader(http.StatusTooManyRequests)
        w.Write([]byte(`{"message": "Rate limit exceeded"}`))
        return
    }
    if r.URL.Path == "/retry-excessive" {
        w.Header().Set("Retry-After", "125")
        w.WriteHeader(http.StatusTooManyRequests)
        w.Write([]byte(`{"message": "Rate limit exceeded"}`))
        return
    }
    w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
    w.Write([]byte(`{"status": "ok"}`))
}))
defer srv.Close()

c := newTestGitLabClient(Options{BaseURL: srv.URL, Token: "tok"})
c.sleep = mockSleep

calls = 0
_, err1 := c.do(context.Background(), "GET", "/retry-ok", nil, nil)
assert err1 == nil
assert len(sleepDurations) == 1 && sleepDurations[0] == 10*time.Second

_, err2 := c.do(context.Background(), "GET", "/retry-excessive", nil, nil)
assert IsRateLimited(err2) == true

_, err3 := c.do(context.Background(), "GET", "/retry-fail", nil, nil)
assert IsRateLimited(err3) == true
